blocks.text: Check our Miss Universe 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features. The Miss Universe pageant has begun the finals of its 75th edition, where the Philippines’ Bea Millan Windorski is vying to bring home the country’s fifth crown. The finals night, which is being held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico on Nov. 24 (Nov. 25 in the Philippines), opened with more than 100 delegates dancing to a musical performance by Puerto Rican artists.
